name: sme-fused-a-panel-paired-transpose
hypothesis: Start from sme-fused-a-panel-staged-loads, the highest measured median. Add a full-block A-packing path that uses all-true predicates, advances row pointers, and processes two rows and two columns per iteration. This reduces packing loop and address work without changing the measured product loop or adding B packing. Keep predicated packing for tails. The wider transpose and four-step product trials did not show a reliable gain, so neither is retained. This candidate is untested; exceeding 1780 GFLOP/s in every repeat remains unproven.
